```python
SwitchRecord(group: str, variants: Tuple[str, ...], rows_per_variant: Tuple[Tuple[int, ...], ...])
```

Part of [`evoxc.transforms`](/api/evoxc/transforms/)

One switch class emitted by `batch_functions`.

## Attributes

- `group` · `str` — The merge group's name — the IR category name for a category
  group, `",".join(sorted(names))` for an explicit op-name set.

- `variants` · `Tuple[str, ...]` — The variant names in first-appearance order (an op's IR
  name; two variants differing only in attributes share a name).

- `rows_per_variant` · `Tuple[Tuple[int, ...], ...]` — The function indices using each variant, aligned
  with `variants`; these are GLOBAL function indices, also when the
  merge is banded.
